title: Isaac Newton
summary: Born at Woolsthorpe in Lincolnshire, Newton entered Trinity College, Cambridge, in 1661 and became Lucasian Professor in 1669. At Edmond Halley's urging he wrote the Principia, published in 1687. He died in London in 1727.

uncertainty.note: Birth falls on 25 December 1642 in the Julian (Old Style) calendar then used in England, which MacTutor converts to 4 January 1643; the start year is the Gregorian one.

as_recorded.value: entered Trinity College, Cambridge, on 5 June 1661

where.modern_name: Trinity College, Cambridge, England (pinned to where he studied and held the Lucasian chair)
where.historical_name: Trinity College, University of Cambridge, Kingdom of England (born at Woolsthorpe, Lincolnshire; died in London)

importance.justification: Author of the 1687 Principia, a founding text of classical mechanics.
